links.outcome: GPT-4 accuracy versus healthcare personnel for detecting IV fluid contamination of BMP results
links.effect: Accuracy 95% CI 0.57-0.71 for GPT-4 vs 0.73-0.80 for HCP on NS set; 0.57-0.57 vs 0.73-0.80 on D5NS set. GPT-4 less accurate than trained HCP.
links.quote: GPT-4 is less accurate than trained HCP for detecting IV fluid contamination of basic metabolic panel results.

links.outcome: Correlation between reported confidence and correct classification
links.effect: No correlation between reported confidence and likelihood of a correct classification.
links.quote: There was no correlation between reported confidence and likelihood of a correct classification.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating GPT-4 against healthcare personnel on simulated laboratory data to detect IV fluid contamination; evaluates model accuracy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
